# 1. Mira approves every new product name

Date: 2026-08-03

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-08-03; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「No product gets a name until I have said yes.」 — Mira Example, 2026-08-03

**Options considered:**
- a new product name is used only after mira approves it in writing (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** product-naming

A new product name is used only after Mira approves it in writing.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.

# 24. Show Mira the full diff before committing; commit messages in English

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-21; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「From now on, always show me the full diff before you commit anything, and write commit messages in English.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

**Options considered:**
- before any commit, show Mira the full diff; write commit messages in English (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** commit-workflow

Before committing anything, the full diff is shown to Mira. Commit messages are written in English. This applies to every repository and to agents and people alike.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
